## What landed (per the 2026-08-18 rulings quoted verbatim on the cards)

**#9761 — decision inbox:**
1. **Standard four-facet block** (升级与决策 section): every `needs-user-decision` card carries at filing — a machine-findable fixed marker (`<!-- os-decision-facets -->`, written escaped, read back to verify survival; extraction greps the literal text so it does not depend on the comment shape surviving), the four facet lines, a one-line recommendation, lettered options (A/B/…), and a **mandatory confidence-gap line** ("what this analysis cannot see"). Case law recorded without card numbers (id-lint): on 2026-08-15 two four-facet-aligned, low-risk, green, reviewed PRs were voided for direction premises the analysis could not see — the recommendation is INPUT, never clearance; the human floor is unchanged.
2. **Pinned digest view**: one pinned digest issue; the triage Routine refreshes its BODY (edit history = archive) via generic query + marker extraction, verbatim block paste, zero paraphrase; authority stays on the cards — the digest is a generated view, never a second tracker (one-board rule).
3. **Batch-adjudication channel**: one maintainer comment on the digest may rule many cards; triage transcribes each ruling onto its card under the existing atomic four-stroke, quoting the batch comment as provenance.
4. **Triage duty line** (分诊座位职责): block validation at inbox intake + low-frequency legacy backfill + digest refresh.
5. **Written script-upgrade trigger**: inbox sustains >20 open, or refresh cadence reaches daily ⇒ freeze extraction into a `scripts/pm/` rollup script — a recorded exit, not a redesign.

**#9699 — multi-repo section:** the stale 「⛔ 现在不铸 `repo:objectos` 座位」 sentence is replaced — the seat EXISTS (maintainer exercised the registered A-upgrade early, 2026-08-18); objectos execution moves from the devx fold-in to the `repo:objectos` execution seat under the same execution-seat discipline as the other `repo:*` seats (⛔ no `domain:*`/type/grading production); triage stays four-repo. The honest-machinery clause is updated: merge queue + required `build` + `merge_group` are LIVE as of 2026-08-18; no-changeset-flow / no-`packages/` kept. The now-contradictory "objectos 执行虽折入 devx" parenthetical in the ACCEPT path-fork paragraph was trimmed in the same stroke (same stale premise, same file, zero net lines).
